maestro_coordination.rule: Enforce strict separation of duties between Bolt, Palette, and Sentinel. Reject any meta-reports, dummy pause acknowledgments, or commits without real code improvements.

bolt.guidance: Focus on real code optimizations in build.sh and core shell scripts. Eliminate subshell fork overhead, streamline loop execution, and profile packaging bottlenecks.

palette.guidance: Refine keyboard accessibility and focus navigation in neos-welcome-app and operations hub. Improve CLI error readability and actionable next-steps for the user.

sentinel.guidance: Harden shell script input sanitization, verify secure temporary file handling (avoid CWE-59), and ensure systemd services adhere to least privilege.
